notes.title: Chest Mate is out fellas!
notes.content:
Ahoy crewmates!

The way to the Ocean is open! Chest Mate is out! Get ready to discover misterious islands and face their dangers to find fame and wealth! Prove yourself as a cannoneer and protect your fellow crewmate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977414/68e0d8cefd312b03e16f2c24ef6a131d2c308a6d.png

In this tower defense/puzzle game, your towers won't shoot automatically for you. You take control of a cannon and shoot whenever you want or can. Time your shots, optimize your focus and, above all, be precise! 

You also place your own walls to obstruct the way. Use your resources well and prevent your enemy from getting to you!

To help you in your endeavor, you will often find interactive elements. Use them efficiently to win the day and you will soon be rich!

Optimize, be precise, get the chest, mate!

notes.title: Playtests are open!
notes.content:
Ahoy fellow crewmates!

It is time! We have decided to open the steam test for our game “Chest Mate” and will be giving out access to testers starting today!

In light of this decision, we have decided to give you a heads up on what Chest Mate is and what you will do in the game.

First off, what is Chest Mate? 

In Chest Mate, you play the crewmate of a pirate ship. Your crew is investigating and digging for treasures on various islands and your job is to defend them from the horrors inhabiting those islands.

To help you in your endeavor, you will be in control of a cannon. You will have to aim and fire said cannon on the incoming wave of enemies using your mouse and the spacebar/left-click button.

SHOOT

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977414/3afbe3126c4509a3b1831eedb0c4e5823de645de.gif

You will also be given resources to use to build walls to make it harder for the enemies to reach your crewmate. You won’t be able to block the path entirely though.

BUILD WALLS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977414/8cba8f43567e7a84b0c2d6702684ada205d59f35.png

On the diverse islands, you will also find different features to help you accomplish your goal:

The explosive barrels: As the name implies, they explode when you fire onto them, inflicting damage to all nearby enemies.

EXPLOSIONS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977414/52990fc1b2b5817d953cb2317ff8b23f8fe2af45.png

The brazier: Shooting through it will light your cannonball on fire which will do area damage on contact and light on fire enemies within the radius.

BURN

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977414/e9e9b74dc4456296259e0e059cebe270bd7bd6a8.png

The Shot-splitter: As the name implies once more, it shatters your cannonball in eight when you shoot it. The shattered parts inflict less damage though. (Placeholder art for now)

SPLIT

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977414/f8ca28bf3992175b794c978c4804b520082153d2.png

Some maps take place during the night, be careful then cause enemies can only be hurt within the light.

NIGHT

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977414/e088f94f942871bc1618c1ab1b2f65a597dee196.png

That is it for the mechanics in the game, I hope you enjoy them when playing the test version! Have a good one! Enjoy!

Kobal
